LESSON: HEAT TRANSFER

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.3: Heat transfer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Heat transfer. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Heat transfer
2. Practise Heat transfer at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Heat transfer

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Heat transfer
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Heat transfer. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Heat transfer at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Heat transfer at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Heat transfer
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Heat transfer. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Heat transfer using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Heat transfer in the examples.
2. Explain Heat transfer to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Heat transfer.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Heat transfer using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Heat transfer important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Heat transfer
2. Practise Heat transfer at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Heat transfer

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
